[P2] Include abandoned CREATE change-set stacks

If a first deployment stops after creating its change set but before executing it, CloudFormation leaves the stack in `REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS`. That state waits for change-set execution; it does not eventually become one of these terminal statuses. Because `list-stacks` uses this allowlist, these closed-PR stacks remain invisible to every subsequent cleanup sweep. Include `REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS` and cover its cleanup eligibility with a regression test.
